**Exam Schedule**

• **Semester Exams**: December (Odd), May (Even)
• **Internal Tests**: September (Odd), March (Even)
• **Exam Timetable**: Published 2 weeks before exams
• **Mode**: Offline written examination

Check the student portal or notice board for exact dates.

**Examination Rules**

• Carry **hall ticket** for all exams
• Reach exam hall **15 minutes early**
• **No electronic devices** allowed
• Rough sheets **provided** at exam center
• **Biometric attendance** for all exams
• Carry your **college ID**

Violation leads to disqualification.

**Passing Criteria**

• Minimum **40% marks** in each subject
• **Internal Assessment**: Based on tests, assignments, attendance (30%)
• **External Exam**: 70% weightage
• Minimum **5.0 CGPA** overall for degree

Must clear both internal and external components.

**Exam Timetable**

• Published **15 days before** exam start
• Check your **hall ticket** for venue and room number
• Download from student portal
• In case of discrepancy, contact examination cell immediately.

**Result Declaration**

• Semester results: **January** (Odd), **June** (Even)
• Revaluation results: 2 weeks after applying
• Check student portal for results
• Contact exam cell for discrepancies

**Revaluation Process**

• Apply within **7 days** of result declaration
• Form available at **Examination Cell**
• Fee: **Rs. 500 per subject**
• Results within **2 weeks**

Note: Revaluation may increase or decrease marks.
